name: Parameters.star_mem_iff
summary: aā = pc lies in w, so a or ā does; not both, for then p·c ∈ w² with c ∉ w, i.e. p ∈ w², but p is unramified.

steps.claim: Write a·ā = p·c with c a natural number coprime to p (ha).
steps.lean:
ha.rec fun _ c ↦ by grind [mul_mem_right, natCast_notMem_sq
  hw (by aesop), sq, mul_mem_mul, w.2.mem_pow_mul, w.2.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem c.2.cast hw]

steps.claim: a·ā = p·c ∈ w (p ∈ w), so a ∈ w or ā ∈ w (w prime). If both, then p·c = aā ∈ w² while c ∉ w (c coprime to p ∈ w), hence p ∈ w² (`mem_pow_mul`), contradicting `natCast_notMem_sq` (p ∤ N₁(P, s)·d(P) by `not_dvd_N₁_mul_d_of_modEq_one`).
steps.lean:
by grind [mul_mem_right, natCast_notMem_sq
  hw (by aesop), sq, mul_mem_mul, w.2.mem_pow_mul, w.2.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem c.2.cast hw]
